name: mechanism
description: A skill that builds inspectable models of real objects from evidence and films them.

plugins.name: mechanism
plugins.description: Model a real object (hardware or software) from published evidence, check it against what is published, and film it with sound, an interactive viewer and an STL/GLB. A model whose numbers do not add up is not rendered.

plugins.name: mechanism-draft
plugins.description: Mechanism Draft only: technical-drawing films (vector Paper sheets) checked by the evidence gate, without the 3D Studio film or the Workflow engine.
